jobs.name: prepare
jobs.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. A professional 2D puppy animation IN-BETWEEN sprite sheet, actual transparent background, EXACTLY 4 columns x 4 rows, 16 consecutive full-body drawings, chronological row-major, no text/gridlines. Fixed three-quarter view facing right. This is ONE continuous motion, not sixteen separate illustrations. Maintain IDENTICAL physical skull size, muzzle, face, cream blaze and paws, brown ears, golden-apricot fur, sage collar with ONE brass disk, dark brown line weight. Same soft cel shading as reference. No squash/stretch, no camera rotation or zoom, no anatomy drift, no detached limbs, no human hands, no ghost overlays. Entire character including tail/feet fits each equal cell with 12% clear spacing, anchored same ground line; don't move character sideways for prop. Weight-bearing canine motion; slow tiny increments between ALL adjacent cells. Spread change over all16 cels, NO pose jump at row breaks. Exact reference endpoints are critical. Image1 is exact START seated neutral silhouette and placement, image2 exact END standing nose down at small green paper scroll; image3 is sharp original identity reference. Draw only a smooth sit-to-stand AND lean-down transition. Cel1 exactly image1, no redesigned or wider dog. Cel2 gaze down, cel3 chest slightly inclines, cel4 chest leans a little more; cels5-10 hind legs extend gradually with front paws planted as chest lowers and rump rises, all intermediate slopes; cels11-15 lower neck and nose bit by bit ending at cel16 exactly image2. Avoid finishing the standing pose before cel12. Skull must be same scale in seated and standing poses; rotate naturally without enlarging cheeks. Tiny scroll on ground by nose location throughout, never touching adjacent cell. Straight paws stay grounded, natural ears follow head, full puppy drawn in each frame.
